slides.title: Ethiopian passport: visa-free entry to 17 destinations
slides.body: A 2026 passport index ranks it 90th, a report says.

slides.title: 17 visa-free, 33 visa on arrival
slides.body: Capital FM reports the figures, attributed to the 2026 Global Passport Power Index. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Five African Union states
slides.body: Kenya, Benin, The Gambia, Rwanda and Togo offer visa-free entry to Ethiopian passport holders, the report says.

slides.title: Why rankings stay low
slides.body: The report cites economic conditions, security concerns and diplomatic relations. Governments weigh income levels, security risks and visa overstays, it says.

slides.title: More visa-free agreements could widen travel.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
